race.comment: EVERY LITTLE THING (7) gets the nod off a sharp first-up second at this track, beaten a nose after travelling well behind the leaders, and her two placings from two starts at this venue read well. Fitter now and will take holding out late. PACKERS JOURNEY (1) comes through a BM66 placing at Kyneton and gets grade relief with a 3kg claim. Going well enough to take this out. BLAZE AWAY (3) drops out of BM62 grade fresh then had excuses at Seymour. He can improve third-up on the quick turnaround and is up to these on best form. ARABIAN MYTH (5) has come back well and was close up in a similar race here last time.
